# Royal Marine Commandos
The [bold]Royal Marine Commandos[/bold] (RMC) are the elite of the [textlink="Three World Empire" link="CMUGuideLoreTWE"]. Highly disciplined and well equipped, they are trained in rapid deployment, boarding actions, reconnaissance, sabotage and precision strikes far behind enemy lines, though they are far fewer in number than other militaries.
